questions.question_text: Dividing a fraction by $\frac{5}{6}$ gives $\frac{3}{4}$. What is the fraction?

options.why: Divided $\frac{3}{4}$ by $\frac{5}{6}$ instead of multiplying to undo the division.
Divided $\frac{5}{6}$ by $\frac{3}{4}$ instead of working back from $\frac{3}{4}$.
Added $\frac{3}{4}$ and $\frac{5}{6}$ instead of multiplying to undo the division.

questions.solution_text:
To undo dividing by $\frac{5}{6}$, multiply by it.
$\frac{3}{4}\times\frac{5}{6}$
$=\frac{15}{24}$
$=\frac{5}{8}$
The fraction is $\frac{5}{8}$.
